notes.text: Note:  This song was quite a chore to get written down.  I tried my best to denote any use of Chinese pinyin in the translation, and though I believe most of this translation to be correct, it is very possible that minute mistakes exist within.  Please don’t be too harsh!

Also, if you hadn’t noticed, this live version of the song is in double time, so the lyrics are really hard to hear clearly.  If you are set on attempting to learn this whole song, might I recommend the earlier, slower version from his first album (which I’ve included below).
